transcript:
Meeting header:
Date: 2025-02-11
Time: 15:00 UTC / 10:00 PT
Duration: 1:02
Attendees: Avery (Redwood), Diego (Redwood), Priya (Redwood), Samir (Redwood), Maya (BlueWave), Tom (BlueWave), Jade (Brightline Agency), Elliot (BlueWave)

Summary:
Quick sync to finalize the upcoming co-hosted webinar series launch plan: roles, channels, creative, tracking, and contingency. Confirm speaker list, production run-of-show, audience segments, and measurement/KPIs. Align next steps and deadlines.

Topics:
- Webinar theme and 3-part series cadence
- Speaker logistics and slide ownership
- Registration flow, landing page, and UTM taxonomy
- Promotion mix (email, paid social, partners) and timelines
- Production plan, dress rehearsals, and backups
- KPIs: Registrations, attendance rate, MQLs, demo requests

Action items (auto-excerpted):
- See action_items metadata for owners and dates

Transcript:
[00:00] Avery: Okay everyone, thanks for joining on time. We'll give folks a minute but I want to make sure we cover the run of show and tracking signoffs. Maya, thanks for taking time.
[00:18] Maya: Yeah no problem. We just wrapped budgeting today so this is perfect timing.
[00:25] Diego: Hi all, quick note, this recording is on. Trying to keep notes inline with the agenda.
[00:31] Tom: Hey, morning. I have a quick heads up — CDP segments will be locked down by Thursday, so any audience changes need to be before then.
[00:40] Jade: Brightline will produce the show. We have a standard studio package but we can do remote presenter feeds too, little more work but feasible.
[00:50] Priya: Great. High level — the series is "Operationalizing LLMs in Regulated Workflows" — three 45-minute sessions, each with a short demo and a customer panel. We want to target health tech and payers. Thoughts?
[01:10] Elliot: That framing works for BlueWave. Could we include an opening case study about reducing inference cost per request? That resonates with procurement.
[01:22] Samir: We can add a slide on cost controls — batching, quantization, and policy routing. I'll sketch visuals.
[01:30] Avery: Good. On speakers: Redwood provides a product PM (Priya), an SE for a short demo (Samir), and we proposed a BlueWave customer panel (Maya + Elliot). Jade, can you confirm AV needs for a 3-person panel?
[01:48] Jade: Yes, we need individual mics for panelists if they're remote; ideally at least one camera on the customer. If it's in-studio it's easier. Also recommend a dress rehearsal 48 hours before.
[02:00] Tom: 48 hours is doable. But will need to coordinate calendars — we run into conflicts with execs.
[02:08] Maya: I can move things around but we need a clear timeblock next week.
[02:14] Avery: I'll send a Doodle after this.

[02:20] Diego: On registration, Samir and I worked on the landing page draft — quick feedback request: headline, 3 bullets, and form fields (name, company, email, role, consent). We proposed a "How are you evaluating LLM infra?" radio button for segmentation.
[02:40] Samir: Also adding a hidden field for account ID if coming from paid. Need UTM params standardized.
[02:47] Tom: We use utm_source=bluewave, utm_medium=email|paid_social|partner, utm_campaign=op-llm-2025-02. Can Redwood map these into the same GA/BigQuery schema?
[02:59] Priya: Yes, we can add mapping and pass to your CDP. We'll need read-only GA view access.
[03:06] Elliot: I'll grant GA access. Also need to confirm PI/PHI considerations — during Q&A we want no patient examples.
[03:16] Maya: Agreed, legal reviewed the deck briefly and asked for a slide with redaction guidelines.

[03:25] Diego: Noted — add a "what not to show" slide.

[03:30] Jade: For production, our default is Zoom Webinar fed to Vimeo for post-event playback. We can also use StreamHub for lower latency. Any preference?
[03:42] Samir: Vimeo is fine for on-demand. For live low-latency demos, StreamHub helps. We should pick one and have a fallback.
[03:50] Avery: Let's pick Zoom->Vimeo as primary, StreamHub as backup. Jade, outline the failover steps in run-of-show.
[03:58] Jade: Will do, including phone dial-in fallback for presenters.

[04:05] Tom: Promotion: we plan two nurture emails (invite and 72hr reminder), one day-of reminder with calendar link, and a 24hr and 1hr SMS to a seeded list. Paid social for LinkedIn targeting titles: Director+ in Health Tech, Data Science, ML Ops. Budget TBD.
[04:26] Maya: We also want partner co-promotion: two hospital systems and one payer. They asked for a co-branded banner and a single-line blurb.
[04:36] Diego: I'll create co-brand assets template. Need logos, hex colors, and legal copy.
[04:42] Elliot: I'll send logos to Diego after.

[04:47] Priya: KPIs — target 1,200 registrations across the series, 30% attendance, 3% MQL conversion to pipeline. For the first session, target 400 regs, 120 attend, 12 MQLs. Does that align?
[05:02] Tom: Seems aggressive but doable if paid budget kicks in. Also measure watch time and retention for demo segment.
[05:11] Samir: We'll instrument an event at demo start and end, so we have demo completion rate.

[05:18] Avery: Reporting cadence: weekly dashboard, plus a post-event write-up with leads CSV. Redwood will send initial event report within 48 hours.
[05:27] Diego: Can we add a minute-by-minute heatmap to spot dropoffs?
[05:32] Jade: We can provide engagement metrics from Vimeo — heatmap per viewer aggregated.

[05:40] Maya: On legal/compliance: BlueWave's privacy team asks that attendee list be stored in-country (EU) for certain partners. Is Redwood able to specify region for lead storage?
[05:51] Priya: We can route form data to BlueWave's CRM directly or to a European data store for partners. We'll document the flow.
[05:59] Elliot: Great, we need that in writing for procurement.

[06:05] Diego: Creative checklist: hero image, 3 social cards (1:1, 4:5, 16:9), two email banners, 1 co-brand banner, and a thumbnail for on-demand. Samir — any special requests for the demo visuals?
[06:20] Samir: Demo will show token latency graphs and an interactive prompt flow. Need clean screenshots and a short video capture of 90 seconds.
[06:29] Samir: Note — token counts must be anonymized.

[06:34] Jade: We'll add 20 minutes to run-of-show for tech checks and speaker mic checks.
[06:39] Avery: Okay, timeline recap:
- Draft deck + Q/A doc to BlueWave: 2025-02-16
- Landing page + tracking: 2025-02-14
- Audience seed list: 2025-02-13
- Run-of-show: 2025-02-20
- Rehearsal (48h prior): scheduled week of 2025-02-23

[06:58] Maya: One ask — can Redwood provide a short pre-recorded 2-min intro from your CEO? Exec availability is tight.
[07:06] Priya: We can do a CEO cameo; would prefer pre-recorded. Need teleprompter notes and a script.
[07:14] Avery: I'll coordinate with comms.

[07:18] Tom: Measurement nuance — we want to attribute pipeline to campaign properly. Use UTM + lead source mapping and pass campaign metadata to CRM.
[07:29] Diego: We'll include hidden inputs for campaign_id and ad_id.

[07:33] Elliot: For the Q/A, legal requests a moderator to screen questions for PHI and escalate only permitted ones.
[07:43] Priya: Suggest we use two moderators — one for content, one for legal redaction.
[07:49] Jade: Brightline can provide a producer to moderate chat and queue questions.

[07:54] Avery: Ok last bit — budget split. BlueWave covers paid social and agency fees; Redwood covers platform fees and email sends. We'll document exact line items in the cost spreadsheet. Tom, can you share budget thresholds?
[08:09] Tom: We'll share a not-to-exceed and channel allocation by Friday.

[08:14] Diego: Any blockers from anyone?
[08:18] Maya: None on my side besides speaker calendar.
[08:21] Priya: Legal signoff for slides might take 2 business days once sent.
[08:26] Samir: I need access to BlueWave sandbox to record demo data.
[08:30] Elliot: I'll create a sandbox account and invite Samir by end of day.

[08:34] Avery: Great — to recap next steps (I'll email): Doodle for rehearsal, Diego sends draft landing page, Priya sends deck skeleton, Jade sends run-of-show, Tom sends budget thresholds, Elliot shares sandbox and GA access.
[08:51] Maya: Thanks everyone. Looking forward to it.
[08:55] Jade: Thanks, bye.
[09:00] Diego: bye.

End of transcript.

Notes about transcript quality: several speaker labels auto-attributed, occasional overlaps in who said what; some proper nouns mangled (e.g., StreamHub transcribed as StreamHit), timestamps approximate.
